name: The David Kempinski
insider_take: Where Bauhaus architecture meets Mediterranean luxury - this is Tel Aviv's most sophisticated address.
whats_special: The David Kempinski stands as a striking example of contemporary Israeli design, housed in a building that pays homage to Tel Aviv's UNESCO World Heritage Bauhaus architecture. Located in the heart of the White City, this luxury hotel features original artworks by renowned Israeli artists and offers panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from its rooftop terrace.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing room on floors 10-15 for unobstructed sunset views over the Mediterranean, and time your arrival for Friday evening to experience Shabbat from the rooftop as the city lights up below.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you steps away from Rothschild Boulevard's famous tree-lined promenade and the largest collection of Bauhaus buildings in the world. The nearby Carmel Market and trendy Florentin neighborhood offer authentic local flavors, while Jaffa's ancient port - just a 10-minute walk away - provides 4,000 years of history along the seaside.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Tel Aviv's Mediterranean coastline
Exceptional luxury amenities and world-class spa facilities
Outstanding personalized service and attention to detail
Exclusive Kempinski Club 1897 Program benefits and privileges
cons: Urban beach setting with city atmosphere
